answer_1.quote: Language models that convert natural language to command-line instructions, a task referred to as NL2SH, NL2CMD or NL2Bash Translation, offer a promising solution to this problem.

answer_2.quote: We present a novel functional equivalence heuristic that combines command execution with LLM evaluation of command outputs, capable of determining the functional equivalence of two Bash commands with 95% confidence, a 16% increase over previous heuristics.

answer_3.quote: We replace the TfidfVectorizer method for comparing command outputs with an LLM. Our intuition is that an LLM can determine more complex cases of functional equivalence by evaluating the semantics of command outputs with relation to the prompt.
